# What you’ll see

Numba implementations shown on SPY daily candles, Gold COT reports, and weekly SPY relative to Gold. Price charts focus on 2023 onward; COT shows its available history.

# 1 · Commercial Proxy Index

8 bar price proxy: `SMA(open − close, 8) / SMA(TR, 8) × 50 + 50`. Above 50 indicates downward intrabar bias.

<iframe src="presentation_assets/commercial-proxy.html" title="Interactive Commercial Proxy Index chart" style="width:100%;height:540px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#10151d"></iframe>

# 2 · Large Trader Proxy Index

`MMA(close − close[8], 40) / MMA(TR, 40) × 50 + 50`. Wilder style average; readings center near 50.

<iframe src="presentation_assets/large-trader-proxy.html" title="Interactive Large Trader Proxy Index chart" style="width:100%;height:540px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#10151d"></iframe>

# 3 · COT Index

Gold commercial net normalized over 13 reports. Dates reflect report availability; Gold candles provide price context.

<iframe src="presentation_assets/cot-index.html" title="Interactive Gold COT Index chart" style="width:100%;height:540px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#10151d"></iframe>

# 4 · Williams Valuation Index

Weekly SPY relative to Gold; EMA periods 2/22, normalized over 156 weeks. The reference market changes the readings.

<iframe src="presentation_assets/valuation-index.html" title="Interactive Williams Valuation Index chart" style="width:100%;height:540px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#10151d"></iframe>

# 5 · Williams POIV AD

Requires open interest. Local SPY data has OHLCV only, so this chart shows candles and volume; POIV is not calculated.

<iframe src="presentation_assets/poiv-ad-inputs.html" title="POIV AD input availability chart" style="width:100%;height:540px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#10151d"></iframe>

# 6 · Blast Off!

One bar: `abs(close − open) / true range × 100`.

<iframe src="presentation_assets/blast-off.html" title="Interactive Blast Off indicator chart" style="width:100%;height:540px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#10151d"></iframe>

# 7 · WillTrend

66 bar average range, multiplier 2.236 (local implementation). Candles show price with the trend line overlaid.

<iframe src="presentation_assets/willtrend.html" title="Interactive WillTrend chart" style="width:100%;height:540px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#10151d"></iframe>

# Ringed swing highs and lows

Down arrows mark confirmed ringed highs; up arrows mark confirmed ringed lows. Each point is confirmed by the bar to its right, and an adjacent inside bar disqualifies it.

<iframe src="presentation_assets/ringed-swing-points.html" title="SPY candles with ringed swing high and low arrows" style="width:100%;height:540px;border:0;border-radius:8px;background:#10151d"></iframe>

# Reading the charts

These are illustrations, not trade signals. COT uses report availability dates; WVI depends on its reference market; POIV requires open interest.
